purpose: A body cell of a TableRow: a label with an optional description, a leading slot (Checkbox, Avatar, Badge) and a trailing slot (an overflow IconButton or a Badge).

notFor.case: Not for standalone use outside a table row.
A cell that leads with a picture.
A value with a delta that shows its direction.

Default.visual: Label in Content/primary (Type/body-sm), description in Content/secondary (Type/helper). A pinned cell takes Surface/page under the row's state overlay and a Border/default edge (Stroke/divider).

Disabled.visual: Label and description in Content/disabled; no fill change.

a11y.role: cell (a th scope="row" when rowHeader is set)
a11y.keyboard: Not focusable; only the controls in its Leading and Trailing slots take focus.
notes: Actions in the trailing slot need an aria-label.
Align end is the numeric column.

openQuestions: Motion: State Default · Disabled has no motion decision in the contract (finding MOT-002 TableCell). Confirm the cell needs none.
